units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:1">Tosef. Sabb. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:1">XV</cite>), 1 <he>יתד של מ׳</he> the pin of the plough; Y. ib. XVII, beg. 16ᵃ.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:1:3">Y. Naz. VII, beg. 55ᵈ</cite> <he>כדי שלא תעלם המ׳</he> so that the plough might not stir them up.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:13">B. Mets. IX, 13</cite> <he>ואת המ׳ ביום</he> and must give him back the (pledged) plough for the day; a. e.

senses.gloss: strigil. Ib. 113ᵇ מ׳ דכספא a silver strigil (which, if pledged, the creditor may sell and give the debtor a common one); Keth. 68ᵃ מ׳ דכספא (such a luxury as) a silver strigil.
